column1:
Key stages of supplier assessment  
and issue remediation:
Supplier submits an Amazon  
approved audit of facility
If issues are identified, Amazon will issue a 
request for a Corrective Action Plan
Remediation of identified issues is tracked 
through follow-on verification audits 
Once in production, supplier is audited  
on a regular, ongoing basis

column2:
If a supplier refuses to remediate an issue,  
Amazon may choose to terminate the 
relationship
